verdict.rationale: Pulumi ships an official CLI whose numeric exit codes are documented for scripts and CI/CD systems, plus an Automation API that runs Pulumi programs programmatically without the CLI. The ecosystem around it fits CI use: preview-only runs, Git provider integrations, policy results in pull request checks, and OIDC short-lived credentials. A community user independently reports running Pulumi in the CI/CD pipeline of all their microservices. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of non-interactive/headless flags and token-based CI authentication, and dedicated CI provider setup guides.
